study: Additional overlap fixed-target cost, parity readouts, known r
threshold_rule: First observed grid crossing, per seed; no interpolation, no removal of censored runs
pairing: Shared raw examples and independent test inputs across filters, depths, overlaps within each dimension and seed
known_information: Known r=(rho,0,...); all methods use identical constrained polar correction
coefficient_information: Independent simulation from public (d,rho) model, no target labels; fixed before confirmation training
preprocessing_cost: Report per (d,rho) once and per-condition unamortized addition to arithmetic times
label_accounting: n independent noisy final labels, no intermediate labels, no label-based model selection
public_baseline: Sign of complete sign plus magnitude filter over all candidate values; no query or private keys; analytic public coefficients
main_scope: Finite dimensional controlled Gaussian study, no assertion of asymptotic exponent matching
uncertainty: Six paired seeds; pointwise Student t mean intervals; n-star median with censoring count
memory: Process cumulative peak RSS, not per-method isolated memory; shared input generation reported separately
optional_public_block: Not run: conditional full-value learner outside bounded scope
